column1: # The release binary's smoke test (tests/smoke.sh, AUDIT.md item 17).  Columns:
# name, exit status, SHA-256 of stdout, of stderr, and the command.  Record with
# tests/smoke.sh --record build/dbg/avon after a change that alters an output.

column5: printf 'S I I (S (K (S I I)) (S (S (K S) K) (K (S I I))))\n' | $AVON reduce --max-nodes=1000

printf 'I X
K Foo Bar
S K K Z
S I I (S I I)
' | $AVON batch --fuel=500
printf 'S (S S) X S S\nS (S (S S) (S X)) S S S\n' | $AVON batch --strategy=copy --whnf --trace-frame --records --fuel=60

d=$(mktemp -d) && ln -s "$R" "$d/r" && cd "$d" && $AVON boot --pier=p r/tests/kernel/pill.skit && $AVON poke --pier=p r/tests/kernel/events.tick.skit r/tests/kernel/events.poke5.skit && $AVON load --pier=p r/tests/kernel/pill.skit && $AVON peek --pier=p r/tests/kernel/events.zero.skit; s=$?; cd / && rm -rf "$d"; exit $s

d=$(mktemp -d) && ln -s "$R" "$d/r" && cd "$d" && $AVON boot --pier=p --pma r/tests/kernel/pill.skit && $AVON poke --pier=p r/tests/kernel/events.tick.skit && $AVON poke --pier=p --snapshot r/tests/kernel/events.poke5.skit && $AVON peek --pier=p r/tests/kernel/events.zero.skit; s=$?; cd / && rm -rf "$d"; exit $s

d=$(mktemp -d) && ln -s "$R" "$d/r" && cd "$d" && $AVON boot --pier=e --entropy=r/tests/fixtures/t1.ski r/tests/kernel/entropy.pill.skit && $AVON poke --pier=e --entropy=r/tests/fixtures/t1.ski r/tests/kernel/entropy.ask5.skit r/tests/kernel/entropy.ask7twice.skit; s=$?; cd / && rm -rf "$d"; exit $s

for c in "reduce --rows=5" "batch tests/fixtures/t0.ski" "witness --statement=s --rows=5" "jam --fuel=5" "boot --entropy tests/kernel/pill.skit" "poke --pier=p --pma x"; do $AVON $c </dev/null; echo "$c: $?"; done
